div.head: Swer 3.2
div.ab: 7 swa ic hit tyme, swa hit me se sealde, ðe ic hit nu on hand sette.
Et sic aduoco, sicut hoc mihi uendidit, cui nunc in manu mitto.
7 swa ic hit tyme, swa hit me se sealde, ðe ic hit nu on hand sette.
Beziehungsweise: só schieb ich es zur Gewähr, wie es mir dér veräussert hat, dem ich es jetzt in die Hand lege.
Or: I vouch it to warranty just as he sold it to me into whose hand I now place it.
[Alternatively:] And so I give a [written] guarantee that they [the cattle] were sold to me by the person in whose hands I now place it.
